proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal to Have an Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy that the Board Chairman be an independent director, separating the Chairman and CEO roles, phased in at contract renewal or CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Public Report on Lobbying Activities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing IBM's lobbying policies, direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots payments, and the oversight process for them.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Public Report on Congruency in China Business Operations and ESG Activities
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party review of whether IBM's China business activities align with its ESG commitments and Human Rights Statement, and board plans to mitigate misalignment.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Public Report on Harassment and Discrimination Prevention Efforts
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent review of the effectiveness of IBM's efforts to prevent harassment and discrimination against employees and a public report of findings.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.
